title: Rscripter Hub
features:
The ultimate all-in-one Roblox utility hub built for zee-hood ect.

🔥 Features:

✅ Clean, draggable Dark Neon GUI with bold blue title

✅ ESP (optimized, R6 & R15, small bold names)

✅ Camlock with smooth aim + adjustable FOV circle

✅ Fly with adjustable speed

✅ AutoFire / RapidFire with custom fire rate (ms)

✅ Keybind Manager (rebind keys, “Saved ✓”, config auto-save/load)

✅ KillSwitch (turns off everything instantly)

✅ Invis Script button (injects Pastebin invis script)

✅ Discord button (blue, bold, copies invite + shows “Copied ✓”)

✅ Smooth Minimize button (top-right, animated collapse/expand)
